svg.title: Hand a ticket to a team you are not on — SoftTrack web design mockup (#286)
svg.desc: Moving a ticket to another team and linking across teams both need write access to both, so somebody on Support cannot give Engineering a bug unless they are also on Engineering. A team can accept requests from outside; a request becomes a ticket in its intake, which the team accepts or declines; and the sender follows the one ticket they sent.

svg.text: A team decides who may ask
Done when a team can accept requests from nobody, from chosen teams or from anyone signed in; sending one creates a ticket in the receiving team’s intake status, linked to the
sender’s ticket; the team accepts or declines with a reason and the sender is told; the sender sees that ticket’s status, assignee and comments and nothing else on the team,
filtered in the query; and the sender’s ticket shows the status of what it is waiting on.
